mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_table (user_id, product_id, product_name, order_id, order_time, total_amount, quantity, status, pay_url, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{productId}, #{productName}, #{orderId}, #{orderTime}, #{totalAmount}, #{quantity}, #{status}, #{payUrl}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT product_id, product_name, order_id, order_time, total_amount, quantity, status, pay_url, pay_time FROM order_table WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND product_id = #{productId} AND status IN ('CREATE', 'PAY_WAIT') ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, user_id, product_id, product_name, order_id, order_time, total_amount, quantity, status, pay_url, pay_time, create_time, update_time FROM order_table WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
